datasets.sql:
SELECT a.id, a.CNTR_NAME,a.SYMB
  FROM COUNTRIES a order by a.id, a.CNTR_NAME

datasets.name: ODS_Cityes
datasets.sql:
SELECT a.id, a.country_id, a.city_name
  FROM cities a 
where country_id = :country_id
order by a.id, a.city_name
